_comment: Shared JS<->Python parity corpus for the post-processor. Every case here MUST produce identical output from GTranslateV4's applyTermMappings (JS) and PhraseTranslation's apply_term_mappings (Python). Only NON-STT rules that exist in BOTH implementations belong here. When you add/change a non-STT rule in either repo, add or update a case so drift becomes a test failure. Fields: name, source (Romanian STT/source_text), input (raw MT English), expected (corrected).
